title: VerifyMAS: Hypothesis Verification for Failure Attribution in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2605.17467v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model-driven multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) excel at complex tasks, yet unreliable agents remain a key bottleneck to system-level reliability. Automatic failure attribution is therefore critical, but existing approaches, such as direct prediction of agent-error pairs and agent-first failure attribution, rely on local logs of agents and miss global failures that only manifest over full interaction trajectories, such as cross-step inconsistencies and inter-agent coordination errors. Moreover, directly predicting failures induces a large combinatorial search space, hindering fine-grained attribution. To address these challenges, we propose VerifyMAS, a hypothesis verification framework for agent failure attribution. Instead of directly predicting faulty agents and error types, VerifyMAS formulates and verifies failure hypotheses against full trajectories. translated_title: VerifyMAS：面向基于大语言模型的多智能体系统故障归因的假设验证方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型驱动的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）在复杂任务中表现出色，但不可靠的智能体仍是制约系统级可靠性的关键瓶颈。因此，自动故障归因至关重要。然而，现有方法（如直接预测智能体-错误对、智能体优先的故障归因）依赖于智能体的局部日志，会遗漏那些仅在完整交互轨迹中才显现的全局性故障，例如跨步骤的不一致和智能体间的协调错误。此外，直接预测故障会带来巨大的组合搜索空间，阻碍细粒度的归因。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了VerifyMAS——一个用于智能体故障归因的假设验证框架。VerifyMAS不再直接预测故障智能体和错误类型，而是针对完整轨迹提出并验证故障假设。这种基于验证的方法将归因分解为轨迹层面的……
tldr: 提出VerifyMAS框架，将LLM多智能体系统的故障归因转化为在完整交互轨迹上进行故障假设的提出与验证，从而捕捉局部日志方法无法发现的全局性故障并实现细粒度归因。
en_tdlr: VerifyMAS reformulates failure attribution in LLM-based multi-agent systems as hypothesis verification over full interaction trajectories, capturing global failures missed by local-log-based methods while avoiding the combinatorial explosion of direct prediction.
